records.title: FLAIR: Feedback Learning for Adaptive Information Retrieval
records.reason: The work is adaptive information retrieval/feedback learning, not a method to reduce LLM inference cost or improve LLM serving.

records.title: Research on data-driven group consensus decision-making of green methanol vehicle evaluation based on BERTopic text mining
records.reason: The paper applies BERTopic text mining to green-methanol decision-making; it does not study LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Latency-Aware Pruning and Quantization of Self-Supervised Speech Transformers for Edge Devices
records.reason: Relevant compression idea but publisher/author/institution primary full text was inaccessible; abstract alone does not satisfy the required body review.

records.title: Diff-Acc: An Efficient FPGA Accelerator for Unconditional Diffusion Models
records.reason: Diff-Acc accelerates unconditional image diffusion models; this is a different generative workload from LLM inference despite the broad FPGA accelerator lineage.

records.title: Prompting Large Language Models for Training-Free Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
records.reason: The work applies prompting to a non-intrusive load-monitoring task; it does not present an LLM inference-efficiency technique.
